posts.caption:
Watch the ink turn into a night in Osaka.

Tsutenkaku Tower, first in pure sumi ink, then in warm watercolor light. Which version would you hang: monochrome or color?

It starts from a photo I took. I translate it into ink-wash style with AI-assisted tools, then refine it myself: tone, composition, upscaling for large prints, and a red seal. A digital artwork, not a hand-painted original.

Both versions come in the set. Instant digital download. Link in bio.

#sumie #inkwash #japaneseart #osaka #tsutenkaku

静 — sei. Stillness.

Stillness is more than the absence of sound. It is a moment when the heart finds peace, and we notice the beauty we might otherwise overlook.

Kinkaku-ji in Kyoto, with autumn maples and a brushed kanji. Swipe for the meaning behind the character and how it looks on a wall.

Created with AI-assisted tools and refined by hand in Fukuoka, Japan. A digital artwork, not a hand-painted original.

Instant digital download with a bilingual Japanese + English meaning card. Link in bio.
